message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend), giving you a three‑day break that includes a weekend.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) | **Jan 1 – Jan 3** (Sun‑Tue) | 2023 New Year’s Day fell on a Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day break. |
| **Family Day** *(Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PE, SK)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** (Fri‑Mon) | Only applies to the provinces listed; other provinces have different spring holidays. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** (Fri‑Sun) | A statutory holiday for most of Canada. |
| **Easter Monday** *(Federal employees only)* | Apr 10 (Monday) | — | **Apr 10 – Apr 12** (Mon‑Wed) | Not a public holiday for the general public. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | **May 20 – May 22** (Fri‑Mon) | Celebrates the birthday of Queen Victoria; a statutory holiday in most provinces. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** (Sat‑Mon) | The holiday fell on a weekend, so it was observed on Monday. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** (Fri‑Mon) | A statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** (Fri‑Mon) | A statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Nov 13 (Monday) | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** (Sat‑Mon) | Observed on Monday when it falls on a weekend. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** (Fri‑Mon) | A statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | — | Not a statutory holiday for the general public; it does not create a long weekend. |

### Quick Summary of 2023 Long‑Weekend Dates

- **Jan 1 – Jan 3** (New Year’s Day)  
- **Feb 18 – Feb 20** (Family Day – select provinces)  
- **Apr 7 – Apr 9** (Good Friday)  
- **Apr 10 – Apr 12** (Easter Monday – federal only)  
- **May 20 – May 22** (Victoria Day)  
- **Jul 1 – Jul 3** (Canada Day)  
- **Sep 2 – Sep 4** (Labour Day)  
- **Oct 7 – Oct 9** (Thanksgiving)  
- **Nov 11 – Nov 13** (Remembrance Day)  
- **Dec 23 – Dec 25** (Christmas Day)

> **Tip for your app:** If you want to support provincial variations, you’ll need to keep a separate list for each province (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). The table above covers the nationwide statutory holidays that create long weekends for the majority of Canadians in 2023.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the provincial breakdowns or any additional details!
